description: We’re a three-person team from SMAN 49 Jakarta with a complementary split: one of us handles Python, data science, GIS, and UI/UX design, and the other handles data processing and video production. We’re intermediate-level builders who love turning raw space and Earth data into something people can actually see and understand.
summary: Lumenwise is an interactive web application designed to simplify lunar landing site analysis for missions to the Moon's south pole. Built with Streamlit and featuring a retro, pixel-art, game-inspired interface, Lumenwise makes complex astronomical and mission-planning data more intuitive and accessible. Through its mascot, Lunar, the platform introduces users to the challenges of lunar exploration, explaining how low solar elevation, extended surface shadows, and limited Earth visibility can affect power generation and direct-to-Earth communication. Its Lunar Landing Site Navigator uses NASA/JPL NAIF SPICE position data (DE440) to help users compare potential landing sites and dates by visualizing the positions of the Sun and Earth relative to the lunar horizon. By transforming complex positional data into an approachable visual experience, Lumenwise aims to support mission planners, educators, and the public in understanding critical landing site conditions, evaluating operational opportunities, and making more informed decisions about lunar exploration.
details: Lumenwise was developed using Python and Streamlit, providing an interactive web application for exploring potential lunar south pole landing sites. It integrates NASA/JPL NAIF SPICE (DE440) ephemeris data to obtain astronomical position information for the Sun and Earth relative to the Moon. This data serves as the foundation for visualizing solar elevation, Earth visibility, and their relationship to the lunar horizon at selected landing sites and dates. The application presents these scientific calculations through an interactive Lunar Landing Site Navigator, allowing users to explore and compare different landing conditions. Its interface features a retro, pixel-art, game-inspired design, introduced through Lunar, the application's mascot, who explains complex lunar environmental challenges in an accessible way. By combining scientific data processing, interactive visualization, and educational design, Lumenwise transforms complex astronomical information into an intuitive experience for mission planners, educators, and the public.
